description: JSON schema for the possible states of a User with respect to an Evaluation.
name: UserEvaluationState

enum.name: EVAL_REGISTRATION_UNAVAILABLE
enum.description: The evaluation is not open for registration, so the user cannot register.

enum.name: EVAL_OPEN_USER_REGISTERED
enum.description: The evaluation is open and the user is registered to participate.

enum.name: EVAL_OPEN_USER_NOT_REGISTERED
enum.description: The evaluation is open but the user is not registered to participate.
